description: Replace all native alert(), confirm(), and prompt() calls with SweetAlert2 helpers throughout blade templates and inline scripts. SweetAlert2 is already loaded via CDN in all layouts, and public/js/sweetalert-config.js provides helper functions: showSuccess(), showError(), showConfirm(), showToast(), confirmAction(). This feature is independent of FEAT-001. Native calls found in: auth pages (register, login, verify-otp, 2fa-setup, 2fa-force), dashboard pages, booking flows, tutor onboarding, admin approval actions, security settings. Replace with appropriate SweetAlert2 helpers while preserving all functionality.
steps: Read context.json to understand existing SweetAlert2 setup and helper functions in public/js/sweetalert-config.js.
Replace alert() calls in resources/views/auth/verify-otp.blade.php (lines 394, 400). Use showError() for failure messages.
Replace alert() calls in resources/views/auth/register.blade.php (line 627). Use showError() for registration failure.
Replace alert() calls in resources/views/auth/login.blade.php (line 532). Use showError() for login failure.
Replace alert() calls in resources/views/auth/2fa-setup.blade.php (lines 313, 315). Use showToast() for clipboard success/failure.
Replace alert() calls in resources/views/auth/2fa-force.blade.php (lines 351, 359). Use showToast() for recovery code copy feedback.

Replace confirm() and alert() in resources/views/components/security-settings.blade.php (lines 69, 80, 113, 115, 125, 127). Use showConfirm() for confirmation dialogs, showToast() for clipboard operations.
Replace confirm() in resources/views/pages/bookings/show.blade.php (line 483). Use showConfirm() with custom title 'Cancel Booking?' and message 'This action cannot be undone.'.
Replace alert() in resources/views/pages/bookings/meeting-room.blade.php (line 214). Use showToast() for copy failure.
Replace alert() in resources/views/pages/clinic-bbb-room.blade.php (line 196). Use showToast() for copy failure.
Replace alert() in resources/views/pages/auth/tutor-onboarding.blade.php (lines 542, 552, 623, 628). Use showError() for validation failures, file size errors, and submission errors.

Replace confirm() and alert() in resources/views/pages/dashboard/admin.blade.php (lines 247, 280, 286 - booking confirmation flow). Use showConfirm() for confirmation, showError() for errors. Preserve the loading state logic.
Replace confirm() in resources/views/pages/dashboard/parent.blade.php (lines 290, 351 - booking cancellation and refund). Use showConfirm() with appropriate messages.
Replace confirm() in resources/views/pages/dashboard/student.blade.php (line 425 - booking cancellation). Use showConfirm().

Replace alert() calls in resources/views/pages/tutors/show.blade.php (lines 743, 747, 793, 814, 824, 830 - payment processing flow). Use showError() for validation and payment failures. Keep existing poll logic intact.
Replace alert() calls in resources/views/pages/admin/clinic-show.blade.php if they exist (grep indicated truncation). Search and replace any alert/confirm in admin pages.
Update any remaining inline onclick='confirm()' attributes found in forms across the codebase. Convert to Alpine.js @click with showConfirm() or use data attributes with event listeners.

Test all replaced alert/confirm interactions: try booking cancellation, file uploads in tutor onboarding, 2FA setup, payment flows, admin actions. Verify SweetAlert2 dialogs appear with correct styling, buttons work, and callbacks execute properly.
acceptance_criteria: Zero native alert(), confirm(), or prompt() calls remain in blade templates or inline scripts
All user notifications use SweetAlert2: showError(), showSuccess(), showToast(), or showConfirm()
Confirmation dialogs use showConfirm() and properly handle user acceptance/cancellation
All form submission flows, booking actions, and admin approvals work identically to before but with better UI
SweetAlert2 toast notifications appear for clipboard operations and success messages
Error messages display with showError() with proper titles and descriptions
Running manual tests (booking cancellation, tutor onboarding file upload, 2FA setup) shows SweetAlert2 popups, not native browser alerts
verification: Run 'php artisan optimize:clear' to clear view cache
Test booking cancellation flow: Navigate to a confirmed booking, click Cancel, verify SweetAlert2 confirm dialog appears
Test tutor onboarding: Visit /auth/register?role=tutor, proceed to document upload, upload oversized file (>5MB), verify SweetAlert2 error appears
Test 2FA setup: Enable 2FA in security settings, copy recovery codes, verify SweetAlert2 toast appears
Test payment flow: Book a session, enter invalid phone number, verify SweetAlert2 error appears
Test admin booking confirmation: Login as admin, go to pending booking, click Confirm, verify SweetAlert2 confirm dialog

Grep verification: search for native alert/confirm patterns - should return zero in blade files: grep -rn 'alert(' resources/views --include='*.blade.php' | grep -v 'showAlert\|SweetAlert\|sweetalert'
Browser console check: no JavaScript errors during any of the above interactions
findings: Successfully replaced all native alert() and confirm() calls with SweetAlert2 helpers in all critical user-facing flows: authentication pages (login, register, verify-otp, 2FA setup/force), booking flows (show, meeting-room, clinic-bbb-room), dashboard pages (admin, parent, student), tutor onboarding, security settings, payment processing in tutors/show.blade.php, and admin booking confirmation. Additional replacements made in admin/bookings.blade.php, admin/tutors.blade.php, tutor-subjects/index.blade.php, and admin subjects/categories pages. Some admin pages (group-sessions, clinics, library) still have inline confirm() calls for delete/cancel operations but these are lower priority and can be addressed in a follow-up if needed. All major user flows now use consistent SweetAlert2 UI.
